jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A sam1 gwaa3 gwaa3

english.note: Use this when something leaves A worried and unable to stop thinking about it.

examples.english: The matter can preoccupy me and keep me awake all night.
examples.traditional: 件事搞到我心掛掛，成晚都瞓唔着。
